required_source_result: D5 fifth-volume bound on an actual original-coordinate cross block
theorem_summary: For an m-coordinate physical block A0=[[C,B],[B^T,D]], any local rank-r symmetric update S of arbitrary norm/sign, and any dense local tail T of operator norm delta, the reserve condition s_(2r+11)(D)>=kappa>2delta gives ||p||inf <= [5 sqrt(2e)+2 sqrt(6 pi m)]/(kappa-2delta). The proof switches between D5 when the fifth final cross singular direction is large and rank-reserve plus a bounded-dimensional receiver after rank-four truncation when it is small.
